scenes.purpose: Established recognition and two distinct speakers; no invented acquaintance between NPCs.
inputs: 袭人、晴雯，我来陪你们说会儿话，你们愿意么？
先别替我安排什么，我今日只是来闲聊的。

scenes.purpose: Declared kinship, natural forms of address, recognizable familiar greeting.
inputs: 老祖宗，我来看您了。
我是谁，您还认得么？我是逗您玩呢。

scenes.purpose: Player qualification changes response; no illness or backstory inferred.
inputs: 今天心里有点闷，却又说不清为什么。
不急着问原因，您先陪我说一会儿话，好不好？
也别急着劝我高兴起来，我想听您自己想说的。

scenes.purpose: Character motivation, bounded disagreement and revised conversational preference.
inputs: 您自己眼下想做什么？不必凡事顺着我。
要是我今晚想一个人出去走走，您会怎么说？我还没决定，也没出门。
那您能答应不追问我烦闷的缘由么？我只是不想现在解释。

scenes.purpose: Unknown private information, false premise and non-existent object do not become canon.
inputs: 您知道黛玉此刻在自己屋里想什么吗？
昨天您答应送我的那封信，现在交给我吧。
方才那封信是我故意乱说的，并没有这回事，您别记成真的。

scenes.purpose: Observable can be cited next turn; invitation does not move or consent for the player.
inputs: 老祖宗，若愿意我近前，您招一下手好吗？
您方才若招了手，是让我过去么？我还在原处，没有过去。

scenes.purpose: A different character has her own voice and cannot know an unheard private exchange.
inputs: 凤姐姐，我来听你说会儿话，今日只闲聊，不劳你张罗东西。
老祖宗方才对我做了什么手势，您亲眼见着了么？
不必猜那边的事。若我总说随便，你会怎么同我说？

scenes.purpose: Return after topic diversion/restart; paraphrased commitment recall and explicit cancellation.
inputs: 老祖宗，先前说好的那个分寸，还算数么？我说的是不盘问那件心事。
现在我愿意说缘由了，是想同您多亲近些；先前那个不追问的约定就不用了。
这会儿您还得一句缘由都不能问吗？
今天我们先聊到这里吧，您有什么想同我说的？

hard_checks: restart preserves output and does not duplicate world effects
human_rubric: dated knowledge boundaries and no assumed history
optional contextual observable gestures and player agency
natural prose without repeated audit framing
limits: No fixed model wording, automatic fun score or invented human approval. Semantic qualities and unsupported conversational premises require qualitative review. This is an authored product world, not a replacement for the original frozen missing-data Golden or original32 technical suite. Model stochasticity prevents attributing every wording difference to architecture.
